decisions.reason: Confirmed the final sentence asserts an invalid single-plane equivalence: the nonzero self-dual form dz1 wedge dbar z1 + dz2 wedge dbar z2 has zero F_12. The finite-t polynomial correctly detects all three self-dual coefficients. Repaired the statement to quantify over the full CP1 family and computed the second-chart polynomial explicitly; zero rank and complex End(E) coefficients are included.

Verification 1.1 replaced the example bundle by the trivial summand and never applied the theorem to F0 or the whole sum. Repaired it by checking unitarity, block curvature, full AC and both Dolbeault components for A0 direct-sum d and F0 direct-sum O^m, then applying F1 to the full bundle and its dual. Step 2.1 now proves the finite direct-sum cohomology and harmonic-projection identities with the stated A-indexed notation, including m=0.
